blogs.title: How LongRoPE Breaks the 2‑Million‑Token Barrier
blogs.description: Dive into the engineering leap that pushes large‑language‑model context windows from the usual 4k to an astonishing 2,048,000 tokens. We unpack why longer contexts are game‑changing, the three technical hurdles that stalled prior approaches, and how LongRoPE’s multi‑dimensional search and progressive fine‑tuning make this size practically achievable.

blogs.title: Unpacking RoPE: The Key to Extreme Context Lengths
blogs.description: A beginner‑friendly guide to Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) – why it matters for transformers, how token positions and embedding dimensions interact, and what happens when you cramp in new positions. We’ll walk through the state‑of‑the‑art interpolation tricks (linear, NTK, YaRN) and show why LongRoPE’s non‑uniform scaling is a game‑changer.

blogs.title: Evolutionary Search Meets Language Models: The Secret Sauce of LongRoPE
blogs.description: Ever wondered how an evolutionary algorithm can help a neural net read millions of words? This post breaks down LongRoPE’s search algorithm: the design of its massive search space, the clever population seeding, monotonic constraints, and how these yield optimal rope scaling factors that preserve meaning across 2M tokens.

blogs.title: From 4k to 2M: A Step‑by‑Step Blueprint for Progressive LLM Extension
blogs.description: Follow a concrete roadmap that starts with a pre‑trained LLM, moves through 128k and 256k fine‑tuning phases, and culminates in a 2M+ context window—all with just a handful of GPU hours. We detail the key hyperparameters, dataset choices, and why each step matters.

blogs.title: Does Bigger Always Mean Better? Testing LongContext with Passkeys & Benchmarks
blogs.description: LongRoPE isn’t just about raw token counts; it must still answer passkey retrieval questions and perform on classic benchmarks. This article reviews the empirical evidence, demystifying why retrieval accuracy stays high even at million‑token ranges while short‐window performance remains competitive.
